{{Quote|Violia got assigned to the AgriCorps. Maybe I can visit her if Master Unskette has business on Dilonexa.|Thame Cerulian's notation in ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="Birth" />}}
'''Violia''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|century]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was a friend of the future [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Thame Cerulian]] when both were [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] but did not become a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] like Cerulian. Violia got assigned to the [[Jedi Service Corps/Legends|Jedi Service Corps]] instead, being sent to work on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Dilonexa XXIII]] as a part of the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]]. Cerulian noted Violia's assignment in his copy of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', expressing a wish to meet her again should circumstances allow.

==Biography==
[[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] sometime prior to [[115 BBY]],<ref name="Birth" /> Violia was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was accepted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at an early age. While [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as an [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], she became friends with fellow student [[Thame Cerulian]],<ref name="TJP" /> a future [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] member.<ref name="LOTJ">''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]''</ref> Unlike Cerulian, who was chosen as an [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] by Master [[Unskette]], Violia did not graduate from Initiate to Padawan. Instead, the [[Council of Reassignment/Legends|Council of Reassignment]] appointed her to the [[Jedi Service Corps/Legends|Jedi Service Corps]] branch known as the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]], which worked to maintain a healthy [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] biosphere on a number of worlds and aided the growth of crops through the application of the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]].<ref name="TJP" /> Violia was dispatched to the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Dilonexa XXIII]]<ref name="Dilonexa">Though [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path'']] only says "Dilonexa," the planet Violia was assigned to must have been Dilonexa XXIII, since it was the only habitable world in the [[Dilonexa system/Legends|Dilonexa system]]. See {{CSWECite|I|189|Dilonexa XXIII}}.</ref> in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], a region [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Rimward]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Following Violia's AgriCorps assignment, Cerulian made a marginal comment about it in his copy of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] trainee [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', in which he expressed a wish to visit her if one of Master Unskette's missions brought him to Dilonexa.<ref name="TJP" />

==Personality and traits==
Though she failed to achieve the rank of Padawan after [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of training as a Jedi Initiate, Violia continued her service to the Galactic Republic. She joined the Agricultural Corps, the members of which had an affinity for growing things and where patience before nature's own processes was a quality valued above all others.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Violia's was first mentioned in [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], a [[2010]] reference work written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TJP" />
